record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare BLAZE_KICK: Blaziken (3 stars), Combusken (2 stars), Torchic (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count, range and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Burns the cast target for a base 2000 ms, deals SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/120/240 by stars, x1.3 if the target was already burning before the cast), then requests a forced displacement of the target to the last empty cell visited by effectInOrientation along the 8-way direction from the caster toward the target. As written, the RIGHT direction loops `x < board.rows` (6) although the production board has 8 columns and 6 rows, so columns 6 and 7 are never visited going RIGHT; if no empty cell is visited, no move is requested and the target stays (the damage and burn happen regardless).

targeting.note: effectInOrientation (board.ts:810-918) walks the cells in the direction given by board.orientation(caster, target) (sign of dx, dy, so a target at a non-diagonal offset is pushed along the nearest of the 8 directions), and BLAZE_KICK keeps the last cell whose value is empty. The RIGHT case uses `x < board.rows`; on the 8-column x 6-row production board (simulation.ts:104, config/game/board.ts) that excludes columns 6 and 7. The final fallback of effectInOrientation (board.ts:913-917) calls the effect once on the target's own cell when no enemy was visited; that cell is occupied, so BLAZE_KICK's callback ignores it and it does not provide a free destination. Pinned-helper probe (strategy and helper text, 6 x 8 board): caster (5,2), target (6,2), (7,2) empty, RIGHT -> no move requested; caster (2,2), target (3,2) -> move to (5,2), never (7,2); caster (4,2), target (5,2) -> no move; LEFT from (5,2) with target (4,2) -> (0,2), not truncated. Behaviour is described as written; the game is not patched.

geometry.shape: displacement along one of 8 board directions to the last empty cell visited; the RIGHT direction only visits columns up to x = 5 (loop bound board.rows = 6) on the 8 x 6 board; no area damage

declaredRaw.label: requested damage (raw), before the burning-target bonus

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]; if the target was burning when the cast started, requested = Math.round(requested x 1.3). handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The burn is applied before the damage, so the burn bonus tests the state before this cast.

declaredRaw.description: moveTo(farthest empty cell along the target's 8-way direction from the caster), forcedDisplacement true

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: a forced moveTo(x, y, board, true) is requested only if the scan found an empty cell; nothing happens if none was found (for example a RIGHT-facing cast with the caster at x >= 5 or the target adjacent to the last scanned column), or if moveTo refuses (the target, or the unit on the destination, cannot be moved). Otherwise the cells are swapped, the target goes to the moving state and its cooldown is set to 100. The displacement is not conditioned on the damage result.

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the target lacks IMMUNITY_BURN, rune protect and the WATER_BUBBLE passive; applied duration = requested after the target's duration reductions; replaces the running burn timer only if longer. While burning the target takes TRUE damage of 5% max HP each second (reduced by weather, Assault Vest, water effects; zero with Well Baked or Magmarizer).

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (240, also the ?? fallback) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Burn duration and displacement do not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The displacement destination depends on the caster's and target's coordinates and on which cells in that direction are empty; with no empty cell visited there is no movement. RIGHT-facing casts never see columns 6 and 7 (loop bound board.rows).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. A second cast on a target that is still burning gets the x1.3 damage bonus; the burn timer is only extended if the new 2000 ms exceeds the remaining time.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30/60/120 (1/2/3 stars), x1.3 rounded if already burning; burn 2000 ms. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied burn duration = requested after the target's reductions.
